en: A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a calm canal or river lined with dense trees on both banks. Small rowing boats are moored along the right bank, while a stone quay and a few pedestrians appear on the left. In the distant background, a tall white church or tower with a domed roof rises above the treetops. The lower margin of the image contains printed captions.
